triggers.alternative_hypothesis: Historical scanned annual reports exhibit scan degradation and multi-column raster layouts that cause page triage failure or OCR word error rates exceeding pre-registered tolerance, requiring targeted acquisition of historical filings.
triggers.direction_or_condition: Trigger acquisition if and only if future benchmark on existing 2 fully scanned + 63 mixed documents yields triage error rate or heading WER exceeding the pre-registered threshold.
triggers.excluded_characteristics: Born-digital PDFs with vector text layers, single-page stubs, unopenable/corrupted files.
triggers.execution_policy: UNEXECUTED_IN_T0_2; requires separate future benchmark execution protocol
triggers.issuer_diversity_requirement: Each acquired historical document must belong to a distinct corporate issuer not already represented in the scanned cohort.
triggers.minimum_evidence_required: Execution and reporting of a pre-registered OCR benchmark protocol on existing frozen scanned documents and pages.
triggers.minimum_sample_size_basis: Sample size must be derived from statistical power calculations based on future pre-registered benchmark variance, not arbitrary convenience.
triggers.minimum_useful_document_type: Fully scanned Indian corporate annual reports from pre-2015 historical fiscal years.
triggers.null_hypothesis: The existing 2 fully scanned documents (91 pages) and 63 mixed-scanned documents provide sufficient triage stress-testing; OCR text recovery does not degrade MD&A boundary detection compared to native prose.
triggers.observable: Page triage error rate (scanned vs native classification) and OCR Word Error Rate (WER) on disclosure section headings.
triggers.required_characteristics: >= 30 physical pages, scanned raster pages, complete annual disclosure (directors' report / MD&A), distinct corporate issuer from historical filings.
triggers.selection_rule: Stratified sampling across historical non-financial corporate issuers with verified scanned representation, conditioned on future benchmark failure.
triggers.selection_rule_basis: Ensures representation across distinct document typographical styles and scanning resolutions without clustering in a single issuer.
triggers.threshold_basis: No objective OCR error tolerance or triage failure threshold has been frozen in T0/T0.1/T0.1R methodology; establishing a numeric threshold requires pre-registration before benchmark execution.
